title: Memento Mori
wikitext:
Somewhat defunct Australian clan.

== History ==
In 2004, [[mustapha]] and [[Mortuary]] played a lot of 2on2. They wore a blue LED before their names and were effectively unstoppable on [[DM6]]. There was a two week LAN in there somewhere. Considering both their names started with "m" they decided they should come up with a name that encompassed the fact. '''Memento Mori''' was settled on and the two soon recruited newcomer of about 5-6 months, [[Umulamahri]], in whom they saw massive talent. Friends [[pred|Owl]], [[thermal]] and [[psikaar]] soon joined their ranks and the lineup was complete.
